verdicts.reason: A and B look pixel-identical. Both flip the reading order so 'DISCOUNT' comes before a tiny 'MERRY'. The MERRY wordmark, which was the original's hero, is shrunk until you can't read it and is jammed into a crowded cluster of characters at the right edge, while the left third of the banner is empty. The characters themselves are shrunk to icon size and clump together, so the design loses its hierarchy and its feel.
